rules.statement: Bind a configuration section strictly to a small options type that rejects unknown child keys, even when it is read before dependency injection is set up, instead of reading it key by key with `section[key]`.
rules.why: Reading keys one by one silently ignores a misspelled key, so the host falls back to defaults (wrong port, no credentials, no TLS, in-memory store) and no message names the bad key.
rules.check: Look for code that reads a configuration section with `section["Key"]` or `GetValue` per key without strict binding or an unknown-key check; a misspelled key must stop startup with an error naming the section and the key, never the value.
